description: This file defines a route component for displaying a monograph page in a Remix application, including data loading, metadata generation, and rendering logic.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Generates meta tags for the page based on monograph data.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches monograph data based on URL parameters, handles spam checks, and returns data for rendering.

methods.name: MonographPost
methods.description: React component that renders the monograph page or a 404 message.

methods.name: getMonographMetadata
methods.description: Extracts and formats metadata from a monograph object.

methods.name: extractFirstWords
methods.description: Removes HTML tags and extracts the first N words from HTML content.

methods.name: trimDescription
methods.description: Trims a string to a specified length, optionally collapsing whitespace.

methods.name: addPeriod
methods.description: Ensures a string ends with an ellipsis, removing trailing non-alpha characters.
